summary: The Taiyuan office and Wuxing posting rows for Wang Xianzhi (p082) convert 太元中 as AD 376–396, which is the conventional Xiaowu era label but not a possible window for these appointments: 尋除 follows the plaque talk with living Xie An and precedes 及安薨 and 俄而卒於官, so the events cannot fall after AD 385. Xie An’s death (及安薨) and Xiaowu’s same-year 殊禮 convert from 太元十年 in the 孝武帝紀 to AD 385; Xianzhi’s illness and death stay a 385–386 未幾/俄而 bound, not a single year, and the 397 追贈/諡 when 安僖皇后立 is retrospective reception (隆安元年 立皇后王氏) that must stay off active life hints. Xiaowu’s 踐阼 is 咸安二年七月 / AD 372. 先帝 is Jianwen’s conventional 咸安元年–二年 span AD 371–372; the verified November accession day already falls in AD 372, so 371 is the era label rather than a Gregorian reign day. s0347 弱冠遐棲 is an omitted traditional age for Xie An and must not become a birth year. Jingzhi’s heir-making needs onOrAfter AD 385 from the death sequence; 義興太守 and the Xi-family identifications remain undated. Legendary 箕皓, Huan Xuan’s undated collecting, and empty hints on undated kin are left as such. No births are stated in the owned units.
